Subject: Re: Verdant onboarding — PO and tax docs

Hi Sara — great to meet you. Welcome. I'm the vendor onboarding lead and will help route this. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) Tax form: Because Verdant Analytics, Inc. is a US C-corp (per your note), we need a completed IRS W-9 (signed) and either an EIN verification letter (147C) or a bank letter that shows the EIN for crosscheck.

2) Other items for PO creation: legal entity name that exactly matches the W-9, remit address, payment terms (Net 30 unless otherwise agreed), and a primary invoice email.

3) Acceptable evidence: signed W-9 PDF, EIN confirmation (147C or IRS CP 575), or a notarized bank letter. Redacted bank letters are acceptable if they include the legal name and EIN.

4) Timeline: if you can upload the W-9 + EIN doc to the Drive link below (or send via DocuSign link) we can validate within 48 business hours and draft a PO within 3 business days after validation.

Drive upload (preferred): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink
DocuSign for signature (if needed): https://redwoodinference.app/docusign/va_po_2026

I'll loop Marcus from finance to confirm payment terms and any additional controls. Thanks — attaching our vendor PO template for your visibility.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com

[attachment stub: Verdant_PO_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks, Mina / Sara. A couple of quick finance items to confirm before we finalize PO terms: 

- Tax classification: please confirm business entity type (Corporation / S-Corp / LLC taxed as corp / sole proprietorship). For Verdant's W-9 please indicate the box that applies.
- Payment terms: Redwood standard is Net 30 EFT (ACH). If Verdant needs invoice-to-pay via wire, let us know and we'll include wiring instructions and a payment security attestation.
- Remit address: confirm the street address for 1099/record keeping.

If you can include the signed W-9 + EIN letter and an invoice sample to the Drive link we'll queue this for payment vendor setup. Expect PO # within 3 business days of validation.

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
